S2 or S3 contains candidate-specific clean progress under the decision definition frozen in the S3 plan

objective: Apply the smallest balanced additional full-dense dose to the frozen H_source_s2 experimental branch, then measure its incremental and total source-worker effect on one fresh paired bank under the decoding condition selected prospectively from S3.

candidate.label: H_source_s4
candidate.reason_four_updates_is_minimal_balanced_: Four batches expose all 64 frozen rows exactly once with shuffle disabled, adding one balanced epoch rather than another eight-update jump.

training_corpus.strict_one_cell_target: Each target reads the files, computes the answer, serializes one compact JSON object, and sends it to receiver_role='parent' in one IPython call.

optimizer_continuity_boundary.reason: The S2 training config retained weights-only checkpoints, so Adam moments and data-loader state are not recoverable.
optimizer_continuity_boundary.declared_treatment: four-update fresh-Adam continuation from the exact S2 dense weights
optimizer_continuity_boundary.not_claimed: a twelve-step optimizer-continuous run from H176
optimizer_continuity_boundary.safety_reason: Re-running twelve steps from H176 would duplicate the completed eight-update job, cost more, and erase the direct experimental continuation path.

preflight: Verify S2 model SHA-256 and STABLE marker before training.
Verify e33 and H176 protected SHA-256 values before and after the rung.
Verify the exact frozen corpus and manifest hashes.
Refuse launch if any S4 candidate, receipt, trace, audit, bridge summary, or final summary already exists.
Require both GPUs idle at the optimizer boundary.

paired_evaluation.force_scope: pristine specialist action and expert identity only
paired_evaluation.incremental_diagnostic_pair: H_source_s2 versus H_source_s4 on the identical task bank

worker_temperature_selection.temperature_zero: Use 0.0 only if S3 produced a strictly positive candidate-specific increase in admission-hard recoveries over its H176 control without regression.
worker_temperature_selection.original_temperature: Otherwise retain the original 0.4 sampling contract.
worker_temperature_selection.freeze_requirement: Strand E/root records the chosen branch and hashes one sampling contract before any S4 evaluation call.

freshness_requirements: zero task-key and task-name overlap with training, S1, S2, and S3
fresh instance roots and no trace replay
disclose the frozen AST generator's finite variant/parity payload support rather than claiming byte-novel AST files
all three arms use byte-identical task contracts and sampling
task bank, sampling contract, and unchanged admission threshold object are hashed before the H176 arm

admission.threshold_source: Copy the S2 final-threshold object without relaxation; Strand E/root assigns and hashes it before model calls.
admission.hard_success_definition: Use the existing committed specialist _hard_success implementation without modification.
admission.primary_decision: Only the H176-versus-H_source_s4 paired summary can admit S4. The S2 bridge is diagnostic and cannot weaken the primary gate.
required_invariants: forced assignment exact for all arms
fixed route and worker provenance exact
zero regressions beyond the already frozen maximum
zero evaluation errors and 16 distinct complete task contracts

decision_boundary.if_primary_gate_passes: Admit only the scaffolded source-worker claim at the prospectively selected temperature; retain S2 and S4 receipts and do not overwrite H176.
decision_boundary.if_primary_gate_rejects: Reject S4 and stop identical-corpus dense continuation. The next experiment must change the training curriculum prospectively, emphasizing clean first-call parsing and one-call compact JSON transport on training-only variants.
decision_boundary.if_s4_regresses_from_s2_bridge: Reject S4 even if an aggregate count appears favorable; preserve S2 as an unadmitted experimental checkpoint until root decides retention.
decision_boundary.if_training_is_nonfinite_or_provenance_c: Mark infrastructure-invalid, do not evaluate or publish, and keep e33/H176 protected.

confounds_and_controls: Fresh Adam state makes S4 a continuation from weights, not optimizer-continuous step 9 through 12; the receipt and result must say so.
The same-bank S2 bridge separates the incremental four-update effect from task-bank difficulty.
The H176 control preserves the canonical admission comparison.
Temperature is selected by a predeclared S3 branch and then held identical across all S4 arms.
The tight scaffold must not repair parsing, arithmetic, serialization, or parent transport.

immutable_results.primary_result: H176-versus-H_source_s4 result conforming to the existing immutable schema
additional_write_once_artifacts: S4 training receipt with optimizer reset disclosed
all arm traces and routing audits
immutable_results.write_policy: write once; no retrospective threshold, task-bank, temperature, or summary replacement
